prerequisites: A student can start the work that will lead him to the presentation and discussion during the final exam only if he has achieved no less than 140 credits.
At the Final Exam, the student can only enter once all the exams in his/her study plan have been passed.

learning_outcomes.text: Present and discuss an internship report or a paper on a specific topic

syllabus_topics: Presentation of a report on the activity carried out during the internship
Presentation of a paper on a topic, assigned by a tutor
assessment_rules: The score for the final exam can vary from 0/110 to 3/110, taking into account the quality of the work and exhibition capacity. The Degree Commission will calculate the final grade by summing the weighted average of exam marks, the final exam score, and a 2-point bonus for students completing the study cycle within three academic years. A "cum laude" may be assigned if the total sum is 110 or greater.
institution: Università degli Studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia — Ingegneria Informatica (MO)
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica (Mo) (Computer Engineering (D.M.270/04)), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
